edge_types.meaning: B uses or requires A. Standard dependency. The primary structure of the spine.
A creates B. Stronger than dependency -- B would not exist without A.
A is transformed into B by an operator.
A places a constraint on B. Bidirectional restriction.
A measures or decomposes B spectrally.
A maps to B via a functor. Used for bridge theorems.
Recursive feedback. Omega feeds back into itself; Pi_0 feeds back into G.
A projects or coarse-grains to B. Macro <- Micro.
Many-to-one dependency. H: (A,B,C)->D with arity 3. Constraint: Preserves Measure.
